description: This file contains low-level arithmetic functions for big number (BN) operations, including multiplication, addition, squaring, and division of large integers, with conditional compilation for different hardware capabilities.

methods.name: bn_mul_add_words
methods.description: Performs multiplication and addition on big number words, with optimized versions depending on hardware capabilities.

methods.name: bn_mul_words
methods.description: Multiplies big number words with a word, returning the carry.

methods.name: bn_sqr_words
methods.description: Squares big number words, optimized for blocks of four words.

methods.name: bn_div_words
methods.description: Divides a double-word (h,l) by a word, returning the quotient.

methods.name: bn_add_words
methods.description: Adds two big number word arrays, returning the carry.
